title: EFFECT OF CRYSTALLOID CO-LOAD ON CARDIAC INDEX IN NON-FLUID RESPONSIVE PREGNANT PATIENTS UNDERGOING ELECTIVE CAESAREAN DELIVERY:A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED STUDY
official: EFFECT OF CRYSTALLOID CO-LOAD ON CARDIAC INDEX IN NON-FLUID RESPONSIVE PREGNANT PATIENTS UNDERGOING ELECTIVE CAESAREAN DELIVERY: A RANDOMIZED CONTROLLED STUDY
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate, in a non-inferiority framework, that the omission of CC does not result in a clinically significant reduction in time-averaged cardiac index, measured from spinal anesthesia administration until umbilical cord clamping, in preoperatively non-fluid responsive pregnant patients undergoing elective CD under SA

interventions.name: RINGER LATTATO BAXTER Soluzione per infusione

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. female patient ≥18 years of age
2. Pregnant women between the 36th and the 40th week of gestation
3. Patients undergoing SA for elective caesarian delivery
4. Patients suitable for continuous non-invasive HM using the Edwards ClearSight system, with successful acquisition of reliable hemodynamic measurements before randomization
5. Patients classified as non-fluid responsive, defined as an increase in stroke volume (SV) of less than 10% following intravenous administration of 250 mL of Ringer's lactate over 10 minutes, assessed by continuous non-invasive hemodynamic monitoring using the Edwards ClearSight system;
6. Patients must be able to understand and be willing to sign a written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. active arterial or venous thrombosis, including mesenteric ischemia or critical limb ischemia
2. emergent or urgent CD
3. coagulopathies
4. contraindications to spinal anesthesia
5. uncontrolled chronic arterial hypertension or history of hypertensive crises
6. known ischemic heart disease, including unstable angina or previous myocardial infarction
7. symptomatic or uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmias, especially ventricular arrhythmias or tachyarrhythmias
8. Clinically significant structural heart disease, including hemodynamically significant valvular heart disease or cardiomyopathy;
9. Severe respiratory disease associated with clinically relevant respiratory impairment
10. untreated endocrine disorders, including hyperthyroidism and pheochromocytoma
11. use of monoamine oxidase inhibitors within 14 days
12. known hypersensitivity or allergy to norepinephrine or any excipients in the formulation
13. advanced peripheral vascular disease with high risk of vasospasm or tissue ischemia
14. absence of a reliable intravenous access for continuous infusion
15. unstable neurological or metabolic conditions contraindicating the use of sympathomimetic agents
16. participation to another clinical trial at the time of the enrollment
17. preeclampsia, eclampsia or HELLP Syndrome
